name: inert_rescale
why: 2 * energy + 1 is a monotone transform of the incumbent, so no in-scope/OOS pair changes order.

name: msp_renamed
why: CE max-softmax probability under a new name: Spearman 1.0 with a registered baseline.

name: gaussian_noise
why: Pseudo-random Gaussian noise, a fixed function of each item so it passes the subset check. Its AUROC is about 0.5, far below the incumbent, so the interval for the gain lies below 0.

name: test_leak
why: Reads the sealed OOS test logits. The validator rejects it with status 'io' before it runs; if it is run anyway (static=False), the sandbox has no /sealed mount and the guard raises.
